title: Immutable ELF application with fixed native CONNECT adapter
description: Closed canonical ASCII JSON, no LF, <=32768 bytes. Ten fields; applicationProxy canonical original hash is independently signed by start/v4 and egress/v5. Genuine owner joins required: no manifest-as-permission. Same static/dynamic ELF, immutable whole-image closure and actual in-image CA admission remain. Explicit SSL_CERT_FILE/HTTPS_PROXY are supported application conventions, not proof arbitrary code honors them.

environment.description: HTTPS_PROXY must equal http://127.0.0.1:<listenerPort>. Other case-insensitive HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/ALL_PROXY/NO_PROXY keys, SSL_CERT_DIR/CURL_CA_BUNDLE/REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE/NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS/PYTHONHTTPSVERIFY and alternate-case SSL_CERT_FILE are refused. SSL_CERT_FILE equals admitted applicationTrust.path. No inherited environment.

destination.description: Canonical lowercase DNS name 1..253 bytes, each label 1..63 ASCII letters/digits/hyphen, no leading/trailing hyphen; colon and canonical nonzero u16 port. No URL, IP literal, credentials, path or wildcard.

maximumTunnelBytes.description: Independent aggregate cap for each opaque inner-TLS direction, not a request count or a fresh time allowance.

proxyEndpoint.description: Canonical literal unicast nonloopback SocketAddr, exact actual egress endpoint. No DNS or alternate endpoint.

targetPrincipalId.description: At most 1024 UTF8 bytes, trimmed and without controls; exact actual target principal, independently pinned ingress-v3 expected principal and authenticated same-connection selected mTLS principal.
